full_prompt_en: A square manga-style character-study page arranges many narrow scenes around a large central portrait of a stern man in a dark green hat and coat. Thin pale gutters divide the artwork into a precise mosaic, and the background in each small panel remains lightly washed rather than fully filled. In the tall middle panel, the man's shoulders slope toward the lower edge while his head leans forward beneath the hat brim. Round glasses frame a focused stare, and angular lines around his nose, mouth, and cheeks make his expression severe. A narrow striped shirt and rust-red tie provide small orderly details beneath the heavy green outer garment. At the left, small panels show older faces in profile, a standing coat-clad figure, and a quieter street view. At the right, close crops repeat furrowed eyes behind glasses above a panel with an elderly bald man and another figure set farther back. Along the bottom, a pair of walking figures, a wide-eyed face, and a dark mechanical front view establish changes in scale and narrative emphasis. Faces are carefully constructed from thin black lines, short hatching, and transparent tan or gray washes; the coat and hat gather the deepest green pigment. Paper lightness remains visible between figures and in the pale urban sketches. Diffuse daylight gives the central face warm highlights on the nose and cheek while the hat brim places the eyes in restrained shadow. The page's restrained ochre, olive, and blue-gray colors allow repeated gazes to carry the tension. The overall composition combines orderly panel geometry with expressive closeups, creating a measured, investigative mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形漫画式人物研究页把许多狭窄场景排在一位戴深绿色帽子和外套的严肃男子大肖像周围。细浅色格缝将画面划成精确的拼图，各小格背景只用淡色洗染，没有填满。在中央高格里，男子的肩膀斜向下缘，头从帽檐下向前倾。圆眼镜框住专注的凝视，鼻子、嘴巴和脸颊周围的棱角线使神情严厉。细条纹衬衣和锈红领带在厚重的绿色外衣下提供小而整齐的细部。左侧小格呈现年长者侧脸、穿外套的站立人物以及较安静的街景。右侧，眼镜后的紧蹙双眼被反复近裁，下方一格则有秃顶老人和站得更远的另一人。底部一对行走人物、一张睁大眼的面孔及深色机械正视图改变了尺度与叙事重心。面孔由纤细黑线、短排线和透明棕褐或灰色色洗仔细构成；外套与帽子聚集最深的绿色颜料。纸张的亮度在人物之间和浅淡城市速写里仍可见。漫射天光在中央面孔的鼻梁和面颊留下暖亮，帽檐则让眼部处于克制的阴影。整页克制的赭黄、橄榄绿和蓝灰色使反复出现的目光承载紧张感。整体构图把有秩序的画格几何与富于表情的近景结合，形成沉稳的调查气氛。
style_prompt_en: The drawn page uses precise panel divisions and varied viewing distances to create a measured visual pulse. Fine black contour lines and short directional hatching define structure, while transparent ochre, olive, and blue-gray washes leave the pale paper active. Large dark color masses gather near a focal region; smaller panels stay lighter and more fragmentary. Close crops sharpen the gaze and expression, then open into quiet contextual views. Illumination is diffuse, with modest warm highlights and shadows built from ink and colored wash instead of smooth gradient. The overall treatment is cinematic, observational, and tense, with disciplined layout holding expressive linework together.
style_prompt_zh: 绘制的页面用精确的画格分隔和变化的观察距离形成沉稳的视觉脉搏。纤细黑色轮廓与顺形短排线定义结构，透明赭黄、橄榄绿和蓝灰色洗染让浅色纸面保持活跃。大片深色聚在焦点区域，较小画格更浅也更碎。近裁加强目光和表情，随后又打开成安静的环境视图。光线漫射，暖亮克制，阴影由墨线和彩色色洗构成，而非光滑渐层。整体处理有电影感、观察性与紧张感，以严谨版式收拢富于表现力的线稿。
theme_en: A suspenseful character-study comic page centered on a bespectacled man
theme_zh: 以戴眼镜男子为中心的悬疑人物研究漫画页
name: 电影感漫画分镜线稿
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
